relTest.notes: Overview in three stages: Before, The inspection and After the inspection, with a log for calls, requests and notes after the inspection. Report check results are kept with the project and can be reviewed and applied beside the report sections. Interview: pick the interviewee; full names are used; the room count is left out when only part of the house was seen; reworded findings are no longer repeated. Report wording corrections (purchase by a family member, access, damage areas, repeated findings joined). The company number in your profile is no longer emptied when syncing.
